text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Man, that was a great race to watch!
McQueen did great, too."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I mean, with Matikanetannhauser, how should I put it... her aura kinda feels different compared to her Classic year.

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text: ...Tannhauser-san, as always, you keep looking forward and continuing to grow.

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text: Alright, I have to do my best too...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm baaack!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, thank you very much!
Though, I guess I still have a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
There's plenty we can still do,
so let's do our best and look toward what's next!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So, about my next race...
I'd like it to be the 'Japan Cup'...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: A rare domestic race where you can test your mettle against world-class titans! It's gonna be blazing hot and sparks are gonna fly!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course it's not like I'm confident
I can actually win, but...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But you see, I really want to take on the challenge!

Since that was the case, without hesitation,
the next race was decided to be the "Japan Cup"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser-san!
Thank you very much for today.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, McQueen!
Likewise!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: We ran together at the Tenno Sho (Spring) too, but I could feel she's grown even more since then.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh? Really!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's not like we've raced together
many times before, but even so—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You were many times stronger than the one I remembered from the academy or other races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: And I felt that keenly in today's Takarazuka Kinen as well.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I see, ehehe. That makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "I was watching you work hard too, McQueen!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you work so hard was so inspiring.
It really gave me courage!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so? Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"We might end up facing each other again
somewhere down the line."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be counting on you again
when the time comes."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yeah, same here!

Our next target race is the Japan Cup!
Aiming for further growth, we'll push forward with all our might!
